title: Deriving the Identity sin(x - pi/2) = -cos x
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use the trigonometric addition formulas to derive the identity \sin(x - \pi/2) = -\cos x.

steps.title: Apply the Sine Addition Formula to x + (-pi/2)
steps.explanation: Write x - pi/2 as x + (-pi/2) and apply sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B.
steps.why: Subtraction of angles is addition of the negated angle.

steps.title: Evaluate Cosine and Sine at -pi/2
steps.explanation: At -pi/2 on the unit circle, the coordinates are (0, -1).
steps.why: Rotating clockwise by pi/2 from (1, 0) reaches (0, -1).

steps.title: Simplify the Result
steps.explanation: Substitute the values and simplify to obtain -cos x.
steps.why: Multiplying cos x by -1 yields -cos x.
